query: Under Talvoran tally rule A, three lots of 25, 52 and 61 pell are recorded. How many pell count in total?

results.content:

Under Talvoran tally rule A, each lot counts for at most 40 pell. A lot recorded above 40 pell counts as 40 pell, and the counted lots are then added together.

results.content:

results.content:

results.content:

Under Talvoran tally rule H, each interval is charged 2 pell per step for its first 50 steps and 3 pell per step for every further step past 50. The charges of all intervals are added together.

metadata.section: Talvoran tally rule H: tiered rate per interval

results.content:
Document: calc-rules.en.md. Chunk 3 of 5. Content: ## Talvoran tally rule C: added share

Under Talvoran tally rule C, the batches of one tally are added together and the sum gains an added share of 15% of itself. The counted size is the sum plus that share.

metadata.section: Talvoran tally rule C: added share

Document: long-reference.en.md. Chunk 10 of 12. Content: ## Varnel sequence, phase 10: marker Kemmis

Phase 10 of the Varnel sequence opens with the marker Kemmis and holds 9 rounds of 10 slots each. The first round of phase 10 starts at slot 7; the last round ends at slot 17. When phase 10 is replayed, the replay keeps the order of its rows but halves each pause. No row of phase 10 moves the marker Kemmis by more than 3 slots past its previous resting place. During phase 10 the marker Kemmis never shares a slot with the marker of phase 3, and a round ends once every slot has been visited. A pause of 3 rounds separates phase 10 from the phase that follows it in the Varnel sequence. Within phase 10, odd rounds carry the marker forward and even rounds carry it back by 2 slots.

Row log of phase 10:

- Row 1: Kemmis moves from slot 21 to slot 14 and rests 4 rounds.
- Row 2: Kemmis moves from slot 12 to slot 25 and rests 3 rounds.
- Row 3: Kemmis moves from slot 23 to slot 8 and rests 2 rounds.
- Row 4: Kemmis moves from slot 14 to slot 27 and rests 5 rounds.
- Row 5: Kemmis moves from slot 9 to slot 26 and rests 4 rounds.
- Row 6: Kemmis moves from slot 8 to slot 21 and rests 3 rounds.
- Row 7: Kemmis moves from slot 3 to slot 4 and rests 2 rounds.
- Row 8: Kemmis moves from slot 10 to slot 7 and rests 5 rounds.
